worldcombat.skill.revenge.summary: Answer the blow at once: a short, straight punch that doubles when the last hit you took came from this very target, shoving a foe off your body along the punch; hard-knocking, but a wall or a whiff leaves it empty.
worldcombat.skill.revenge.use.0: Answer a foe that just closed in and hit you
worldcombat.skill.revenge.use.1: Knock a charging foe back off your body
worldcombat.skill.revenge.use.2: Punish an enemy that strikes you first at close range
worldcombat.skill.revenge.description.0: The punch deals about %1$s physical damage; if this very target was the last one to hurt you within the past %2$s seconds the hit is doubled, and a later blow from anyone else cancels it.
worldcombat.skill.revenge.description.1: Drives the fist up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block hit radius; the first non-ally it meets is struck and shoved about %4$s blocks along the punch, while a wall or a whiff leaves it empty and still costs recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.revenge.endure.on: Endure on: the grudge window is 0.8s longer and knockback is ×1.20, so you stand and wait for the foe to swing first; in exchange the hit is about ×0.92, the wind-up is 2 ticks longer and the cooldown is 6 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.revenge.endure.off: Endure off: the hit is about ×1.06 and the punch comes faster, answering the moment you are struck.
worldcombat.skill.revenge.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds it spends %4$s PP to fire, then recovers for %3$s seconds and starts a %5$s second cooldown on commit.
worldcombat.skill.revenge.growth.0: At level %1$s the retort power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.revenge.growth.1: At level %1$s the retort power rises to %2$s and the knockback rises to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.revenge.preference.end: On: the grudge window is 0.8s longer and knockback is ×1.20, standing to take the first swing; but the hit is ×0.92, the wind-up is 2 ticks longer and the cooldown is 6 ticks longer. Off: the hit is ×1.06 and the punch is faster.
Stand and answer only threats within this distance; raise it to close on a foe that recently hit you.
On: the foe that hit you most recently is chosen as the target (usually still inside the doubling window); off: the current target is kept.
